name: @celljs/ta-voice
description: A pi package for Ta: real-time voice services for calls, OpenAI Realtime, Qwen-Omni Realtime of Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Hy Realtime of Tencent Hunyuan and the real-time voice of Doubao on Volcengine, to listen with barge-in and read aloud
